title: Max of Three
description: Find the maximum and minimum of numbers, work with arrays, and build a range calculator.

steps.title: Maximum of two numbers
steps.description: Write a `maxOfTwo` function that returns the larger of two numbers using an `if` statement.
hints: Compare a and b using if (a > b)

verification.successMessage: 10 is max of 5 and 10, 20 is max of 20 and 3!
verification.failureMessage: maxOfTwo(5, 10) should be 10, maxOfTwo(20, 3) should be 20.

steps.title: Maximum of three
steps.description: Write a `maxOfThree` function that returns the largest of three numbers by using your `maxOfTwo` function.
hints: First find the max of the first two numbers
Then find the max of that result and the third number

verification.successMessage: 10 is max of (5,10,3), 7 is max of (1,7,4)!
verification.failureMessage: maxOfThree(5, 10, 3) should be 10, maxOfThree(1, 7, 4) should be 7.

steps.title: Max of an array
steps.description: Write a `maxOfArray` function that returns the largest number in an array using either `Math.max()` or a loop.
hints: Or use a loop: start with numbers[0] and compare each

steps.title: Min of an array
steps.description: Write a `minOfArray` function that returns the smallest number in an array.
hints: Or write it manually with a loop

steps.title: Range function
steps.description: Write a `range` function that takes an array and returns the difference between the max and min values.
hints: This is also called the statistical range
